title: Program Technician (Recent Graduate) — Farm Service Agency
summary: This position is located in the Farm Service Agency, Seguin, Guadalupe County, Texas. The incumbent will receive on-the-job training to develop proficiency in all functions and operations of the Field Office. Duties include but are not limited to clerical support, loan processing and servicing, office management, general information, and public relations. $41,334–$66,563 per year

title: Engineering Equipment Operator — U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service
summary: This position is an Engineering Equipment Operator, WG-5716-10, with the U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service, Department of the Interior, stationed at the Aransas National Wildlife Refuge in Austwell, Texas (Region 2). Salary Range Information (Per Annum): $33.57 - $39.25 per hour *First time hires to the Federal government normally start at the step 1 rate. $34–$39 per hour

title: Pharmacist (Clinical Specialist) — Veterans Health Administration
summary: The Clinical Pharmacy Specialist (CPS) functions as part of the Geriatrics and Extended Care Programs. This CPS promotes and manages drug therapy based on current clinical knowledge that is consistent with policies established at the national, VISN, and local levels.
